title: AWS VPC Basics: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Imagine owning a private condo in a huge city. Nobody else can walk in. That's an A W S V P C.

lines.t: A condo in a big city

scenes.heading: The big city condo
scenes.narration: A V P C has a few building blocks. A V P C is your private network inside one region. Plan the address range carefully, because the C I D R can't be changed. Each subnet lives in exactly one availability zone. A subnet is public only if its route table points at an internet gateway.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. A V P C lives in one region. A subnet lives in one zone. It needs a route to an internet gateway.

items.wrong: Any subnet is public by default

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva AWS VPC lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. A V P C is a private network in one region. A subnet lives in one zone. Public means a route to an internet gateway. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva AWS VPC lab.
